info.title: Pretoscop B2B price intelligence API
info.description: Prices observed by Pretoscop on Romanian online shops, for the SKUs your workspace tracks. Amounts in lei (RON) including VAT, as decimal strings; times in UTC. Every request counts against the daily quota of your plan (Europe/Bucharest days). Data-usage terms: https://pretoscop.ro/pentru-companii/termeni (no resale, no publication, no AI training). No consumer personal data and no Open Icecat content is ever returned.
